from: August book, night 7 (The Joy of the Lord)
p1: Ezra loved the Lord’s words. He got his heart ready to learn them, live them and teach them.
All the people gathered in Jerusalem. Men, women and all who could understand came to listen.
Ezra stood up high on a wooden stand. He opened the book of the Lord’s commandments, and all the people stood up! He read from morning until noon.
p2: Helpers explained the words so everyone understood. The people cried when they heard the Lord’s words. But Nehemiah and Ezra said, “Do not be sad. The joy of the Lord is your strength!” So the people shared food and were very glad.
The Lord’s words can make you glad and strong too. Tonight, ask a grown-up to read you one verse.
old: When the walls were finished, all the people gathered together in one big place. They wanted to hear Heavenly Father’s holy words.
Good Ezra stood on a tall wooden platform and opened the scriptures. He read out loud from early morning, and everyone listened carefully with all their hearts.
As they listened, some of the people began to cry. They were sorry for the times they had forgotten Heavenly Father. But the leaders said something kind: “Don’t be sad today! This is a happy day.”

Then came the best part: “The joy of the Lord is your strength!” So the people wiped their tears, shared yummy food with everyone, and celebrated. It was one of the happiest days ever — all because of Heavenly Father’s words.
